backend/main.mo: Defines actor with types and CRUD logic for products, customers, orders, profiles, and access control enforcement using role-based permissions.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature evidence mapping features to involved files, components, and tests for the project.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries for major frontend files including pages, components, and hooks.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS config defining design tokens and theme variables for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point that mounts the React app and loads main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router routes, authentication handling, and main application structure.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/LowInv: Displays a card listing up to five products with quantity below a threshold using product query data.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Pendin: Shows up to five pending orders with customer info and navigates to invoice details on row click.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/SalesC: Generates a 30‑day sales line chart from order data and renders it with Recharts.
frontend/src/components/invoice/InvoiceA: Renders an A5‑style printable invoice with customer, items, totals, and a canvas‑generated UPI QR placeholder.
frontend/src/components/TopNavBar.tsx: Implements the top navigation bar with dropdown menus, active-state logic, and logout handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context, loading identities, handling login, logout, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for products, customers, and orders using the backend actor for CRUD operations.
frontend/src/index.css: Configures Tailwind base layers, theme CSS variables for light/dark modes, and print-specific styling.
frontend/src/layouts/AppLayout.tsx: Layout component that enforces authentication, renders navigation, page content, and footer.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes React app, wrapping it with query client and Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Dashboard showing sales, payments, stock widgets, and related chart components.
frontend/src/pages/inventory/InventoryPa: Inventory management page with product listing, search, and add/edit/delete dialogs.
Placeholder ledger page indicating missing backend support for account tracking.
frontend/src/pages/inventory/OrderBookPa: Displays searchable order list with status badges and navigation to invoices.
frontend/src/pages/inventory/PurchasePag: Placeholder purchase entry page noting backend support is not implemented.
frontend/src/pages/inventory/SalesPage.t: Placeholder sales entry page indicating unimplemented backend functionality.
frontend/src/pages/invoice/InvoicePage.t: Loads order details to render an invoice with print and download actions.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login form validating demo credentials and triggering Internet Identity login.
frontend/src/pages/register/CustomersPag: Implements full customer CRUD with search, dialogs, and hooks for listing, adding, editing, and deleting customers.
frontend/src/pages/register/UsersPage.ts: Displays a placeholder user management page indicating backend functionality is not yet implemented.
Shows a vendor management placeholder page noting missing backend support.
frontend/src/pages/reports/ReportsPage.t: Provides placeholder report cards and alerts indicating reporting requires backend implementation.
frontend/src/pages/settings/SettingsPage: Renders settings placeholders for credentials, payment config, and business settings pending backend support.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, persisting, and clearing URL and session parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures TailwindCSS theme, colors, animations, and plugins for the frontend.
project_state.json: Project metadata file summarizing requirements, architecture notes, issues, and existing implemented features.
